claims.title: Original point operator and whole form domain
claims.submitted_statement: Recover the original point-source operator, dilation, units and H1 form domain. The claimed all-space lower retains every angular/radial direction.

claims.title: Divergence-matched point lower
claims.submitted_statement: Prove the stated bounded vector-field norm/divergence, no origin distribution, exact completed gradient-square form and its extension by density; derive the spin-two occupied lower before antisymmetric restriction. Do not infer saturation from a nongradient field.

claims.title: Finite-core form identity
claims.submitted_statement: Reconstruct the radial multiplier, matching at the core, distributional divergence and uniform anisotropic lower for the original finite-core potential, without extra sign assumptions.

claims.title: Pauli split and positive pair law
claims.submitted_statement: Prove the hydrogenic occupation sum and optimized kinetic split for the original scalar-plus-anisotropic atom, combine with its independent finite-core floor, and retain exact hypotheses on the pair interaction and kinetic law.

claims.title: Declared common-geometry extension
claims.submitted_statement: Check the source-defined lapse/orthonormal-frame divergence extension on its actual metric and form domain. State exactly which geometry is covered and whether extra radial-derivative terms are required.

claims.title: Logarithmic basis and complete integrals
claims.submitted_statement: Rebuild the regular and logarithmic trial basis, all Gram/gradient/potential integrals, angular couplings and full-domain integrability from definitions. This is a variational witness, not a cutoff lower or regularity theorem.

claims.title: Frozen one-electron witness
claims.submitted_statement: Independently certify the frozen logarithmic witness normalization and Rayleigh upper from primary coefficients and complete integrals, and reconstruct its stated improvement. Preserve failed predecessors and floating discovery versus directed verification.

claims.title: Complete occupied Pauli prefixes
claims.submitted_statement: Rebuild the frozen spin-two orbital witnesses, their full Gram/cross terms, orthogonality and every occupied prefix used in the phase/binding panel; verify the six-electron trace and the balanced preparation witness under their own conventions.

claims.title: Original envelopes and source reference
claims.submitted_statement: Reconstruct the original five point-source nuclear envelopes, sector sets and ground reference. Check the source minima used by the submitted binding panel, not only a selected nuclear sector.

claims.title: Six intermediate phase guarantees
claims.submitted_statement: For each electron count independently reconstruct its occupied upper, the complete C12_343 intermediate-sector interval and strict nonemptiness using the whole-space lower; distinguish a sufficient interval from a true transition.

claims.title: Complete point binding panel
claims.submitted_statement: Independently reproduce every submitted original point binding account with its source, coupling, electron count, physical convention and full reference; preserve the one-sided meaning of each endpoint and the scope of the fourfold upper improvement.

claims.title: Generic complete finite-core carbon bounds
claims.submitted_statement: Recompute the weak-polarization three-carbon complete lower/reference comparisons with core self retained in both minima, and reproduce the reported generic improved upper endpoints.

claims.title: C444 intrinsic-gap refinement
claims.submitted_statement: Verify the original intrinsic source gap against its complete source roster/envelope, separately justify both reference minima and reconstruct the sharper complete neutral C444 endpoint. No massive or ionization transfer is implied.
